title: FORT PIERCE HARBOR MAINTENANCE DREDGING, ST. LUCIE COUNTY, FLORIDA
description: DESCRIPTION OF WORK: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Jacksonville District, intends to issue an Invitation for Bid (IFB) to award a single firm fixed-price contract. Project work includes maintenance dredging of Fort Pierce Harbor with excavated material being placed onto Fort Pierce Beach. Due to the extensive hardbottom areas located offshore of the fill area, offshore pipeline access to the beach site is prohibited. Offloading the beach fill will be done inside the South Jetty of Fort Pierce Inlet, as shown on the drawings. A staging area and beach access to the beach placement area are located at the end of Seaway Drive and near the south jetty pumpout location. Work also includes but is not limited to environmental and water quality monitoring, sea turtle trawl sweeping (hopper dredges only), screening, beach tilling, beach fill quality control, construction support, and vibration control and monitoring. Work will be divided into a base and two options. A pre-bid site visit will be held on Monday, 28 September 2026 at 10:00 AM EDT. Refer to Site Visit in Section 00 73 00 of the Specifications for additional details regarding location and registration instructions. A pre-bid conference will also be held virtually on Tuesday, 29 September 2026 at 10:00 AM EDT. Utilize the following link and call-in information Microsoft Teams Meeting: HTTPS://WWW.MICROSOFT.COM/EN-US/MICROSOFT-TEAMS/JOIN-A-MEETING Meeting ID: Meeting ID: 993 213 964 588 | Passcode: qQ9LT3zi Dial-In: +1 601-262-2433 | Passcode: 453 007 326#. NAICS Code is: 237990, Dredging and Surface Cleanup Activities The Small Business Standard is $37 million. The Estimated Magnitude of construction is between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000. The anticipated period of performance associated with this requirement is: The Contractor shall be required to (a) commence work under this contract within SIXTY (60) calendar days after the date the Contractor receives the Notice to Proceed (NTP), (b) prosecute the work diligently, and (c) complete the entire work ready for use not later than 30 May 2027, and be off the beach by 30 June 2027 for the entire contract work. The time stated for completion shall include final cleanup of the premises. NOTE: Notice to Proceed (NTP) will be issued between 60 and 90 calendar days after award or after all required bonds are in place, whichever is later. THIS WILL BE AN UNRESTRICTED SOLICITATION. U.S. COAST GUARD CERTIFIED DREDGE EQUIPMENT IS REQUIRED TO COMPLETE THE WORK. The Invitation for Bid (IFB) will be issued on or about 10 September 2026 and bids will be due on or about 22 October 2026. Actual dates and times will be identified in the solicitation. The solicitation will be issued in electronic format only and will be posted on the Sam.gov website at https://sam.gov/. In order to receive notification of any amendments to this solicitation, interested vendors must REGISTER AS AN INTERESTED VENDOR on the Sam.gov website at https://sam.gov/. If you are not registered, the Government is not responsible with providing you with notification of any amendments to this solicitation. You must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) in order to be eligible to receive an award from this solicitation. For additional information, please call 866-606-8220 or visit the SAM website at https://www.sam.gov/. All inquiries must be in writing via ProjNet. Instructions on how to access ProjNet will be included in the solicitation. All answers will be provided in writing via ProjNet. The only authorized transmission method for a bid in response to this solicitation is electronically via the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) Solicitation Module. NO OTHER TRANSMISSION METHODS (EMAIL, FACSIMILE, REGULAR MAIL, HAND CARRIED, ETC.) WILL BE ACCEPTED. The bids must be received by the Government by the date/time specified in the solicitation. Bidders shall submit their bid via the PIEE website?s Solicitation Module using the following link: https://piee.eb.mil/. Instructions on how to submit a bid can be found using the following link: https://pieetraining.eb.mil/wbt/sol/Posting_Offer.pdf

buyer: Police cantonale de Saint-Gall – Garage de la police
title: Remplacement des véhicules REPO
description:
La police cantonale de Saint-Gall (Kapo SG) dispose d’un parc automobile composé d’un grand nombre de véhicules répondant à des exigences variées. Parmi ceux-ci figurent, en fonction des conditions d’intervention, aussi bien des véhicules entièrement électriques (BEV) que des véhicules équipés d’un moteur à combustion. En raison de leur kilométrage élevé et de leur utilisation intensive, ces véhicules doivent être remplacés régulièrement. L’utilisation des BEV est influencée – outre les conditions d’intervention – directement par la disponibilité des bornes de recharge sur place, qui peut varier considérablement d’un site à l’autre. Cela a donc une incidence sur les quantités de BEV à acquérir.


Les véhicules suivants, actuellement en service, doivent être remplacés :


Bus d’intervention :


Afin de pouvoir transporter non seulement le matériel d’intervention nécessaire à l’usage quotidien, mais aussi un chien dans des conditions adaptées à son espèce, il faut disposer non seulement d’une charge utile élevée, mais aussi d’un espace suffisant. De plus, le bus est également utilisé sur l’autoroute, ce qui nécessite une puissance suffisante pour pouvoir se déplacer avec agilité dans la circulation, en particulier lors d’un trajet d’urgence.


Véhicules de base :


Pour le service mobile, des véhicules mixtes sont utilisés comme véhicules de base. Ceux-ci sont équipés de matériel d’intervention standardisé, dont les exigences en matière d’espace et de poids sont prédéfinies. Le véhicule doit répondre aux normes de sécurité actuelles et offrir un confort de conduite adéquat ainsi qu’une puissance suffisante.


Véhicules de poste :


Le véhicule de poste doit transporter du matériel d'intervention standardisé. Il est donc également indispensable qu'il dispose d'un espace et d'une charge utile suffisants. Le véhicule de poste est plutôt utilisé en milieu urbain, ce qui explique que sa puissance moteur soit légèrement inférieure à celle des autres véhicules.

title: Un système XPS de pointe équipé d'une source UV pour l'UPS, d'un canon à ions monoatomiques et d'un canon à agrégats gazeux pour le profilage en profondeur
description:
L'Institut des sciences et ingénierie chimiques (ISIC) de l'École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) souhaite acquérir un système XPS de pointe équipé d'une source UV pour l'UPS, d'un canon à ions monoatomiques et d'un canon à agrégats gazeux pour le profilage en profondeur. L'instrument sera en accès libre et servira environ 40 groupes de recherche, principalement de l'ISIC et de l'Institut des sciences et ingénierie des matériaux (IMX), ainsi que d'autres utilisateurs de l'ensemble de l'EPFL. Dans ce contexte multi-utilisateurs, une manipulation aisée de l’instrument et de son logiciel, un faible risque de mauvaise manipulation, des artefacts de mesure limités, ainsi qu'une rotation rapide et efficace entre utilisateurs sont des prérequis essentiels. 

En raison de la grande diversité des recherches menées à l'EPFL, l'instrument choisi devra offrir un large éventail de fonctionnalités. Il ne devra pas se limiter à un type particulier de mesure et devra rester ouvert à de futures mises à niveau et développements.

title: Un microscope à illumination structurée pour la Plateforme BioImaging & Optics
description:
L’École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) souhaite acquérir un microscope à illumination structurée pour la Plateforme BioImaging & Optics (PTBIOP) de la Faculté des Sciences de la Vie (SV). Ce système soutiendra des activités de recherche de pointe dans le domaine des sciences de la vie et constituera une ressource technologique essentielle pour la communauté d’utilisateurs de la plateforme. 

Conformément aux besoins de l’EPFL et aux objectifs spécifiques de la PTBIOP, une attention particulière sera accordée aux critères suivants : 

• Technologie avancée : un microscope à illumination structurée de dernière génération, offrant une résolution supérieure à la limite de diffraction.

• Haute sensibilité : d’excellentes performances de détection permettant l’imagerie d’échantillons biologiques exigeants.

• Flexibilité et simplicité d’utilisation : un système adaptable, facile à utiliser et approprié pour une large gamme d’applications, accessible aux chercheurs de différents niveaux d’expérience.

VII. OFERTY SKŁADANE WSPÓLNIE: 1. Wykonawcy mogą wspólnie ubiegać się o udzielenie zamówienia. 2. W przypadku składania oferty przez Wykonawców wspólnie ubiegających się o udzielenie zamówienia (konsorcjum), Wykonawcy ustanawiają pełnomocnika do reprezentowania ich w postępowaniu albo do reprezentowania ich w postępowaniu i zawarcia umowy (lider konsorcjum). Pełnomocnikiem konsorcjum jest Wykonawca, który zaloguje się na swoim profilu Wykonawcy i składając ofertę w zakładce „Wykonawcy” doda pozostałych Wykonawców wpisując ich dane. Pełnomocnik, o którym mowa powyżej, pozostaje w kontakcie z Zamawiającym w toku postępowania i do niego Zamawiający kieruje informacje, korespondencję itp. Wszelkie oświadczenia pełnomocnika Zamawiający uzna za wiążące dla wszystkich Wykonawców składających ofertę wspólną. 3. Do oferty wspólnej Wykonawcy dołączają pełnomocnictwo. 4. Nie dopuszcza się uczestniczenia któregokolwiek z Wykonawców wspólnie ubiegających się o udzielnie zamówienia w więcej niż jednej grupie Wykonawców wspólnie ubiegających się o udzielenie zamówienia. A nr 017 016 046 zlokalizowanego w km 16+046 linii kolejowej nr 17 i w km 21+056 linii kolejowej nr 25 wraz z infrastrukturą towarzyszącą oraz dostosowaniem systemu sterowania ruchem kolejowym (srk); • przebudowę istniejących peronów stacji Justynów oraz zapewnienie dojść z projektowanego tunelu na perony za pomocą schodów i pochylni; • rozbudowę i przebudowę przyległego układu drogowego (ul. Główna, ul. Lokatorska, ul. Graniczna, ul. Rumiankowa) wraz z budową chodników, miejsc parkingowych oraz oświetlenia drogowego; • rozbiórkę, budowę i/lub przebudowę kolidujących sieci uzbrojenia terenu, podziemnych i naziemnych, w niezbędnym i koniecznym zakresie umożliwiającym zrealizowanie założonego przedsięwzięcia budowalnego (sieci elektroenergetyczne, telekomunikacyjne, sieć trakcyjna, gazowa, wodociągowa, kanalizacyjna); • budowę kanałów technologicznych; • budowę odwodnienia projektowanego układu drogowego (wraz z agregatem prądotwórczym na potrzeby pompowni wód), obiektów inżynierskich, peronów i torowiska; • wycinkę drzew i krzewów kolidujących z inwestycją oraz wykonanie nasadzeń kompensacyjnych; • uzyskanie w imieniu Zamawiającego wszystkich niezbędnych decyzji administracyjnych, w szczególności decyzji o zezwoleniu na realizację inwestycji drogowej (ZRID), decyzji o środowiskowych uwarunkowaniach, pozwoleń wodnoprawnych oraz innych wymaganych prawem zgód, uzgodnień i opinii. Dokumentacja projektowa będąca przedmiotem zamówienia powinna zostać opracowana w sposób umożliwiający uzyskanie prawomocnej decyzji o zezwoleniu na realizację inwestycji drogowej (ZRID), a następnie zrealizowanie zaprojektowanych robót budowlanych zgodnie z przepisami prawa i zasadami wiedzy technicznej. Wykonawca jest zobowiązany do uzyskania w imieniu Inwestora prawomocnej decyzji o zezwoleniu na realizację inwestycji drogowej (ZRID) lub – w zakresie, w jakim nie jest ona wymagana – pozwolenia na budowę lub zgłoszenia zamiaru wykonania robót budowlanych. Wykonawca jest również zobowiązany do uzupełniania, składania wyjaśnień i korygowania przygotowanych dokumentów po złożeniu wniosków o wydanie decyzji administracyjnych, opinii, uzgodnień lub pozwoleń, aż do uzyskania ich ostateczności. Realizacja zadania ma na celu poprawę bezpieczeństwa ruchu drogowego i kolejowego, eliminację kolizji w poziomie torów oraz usprawnienie komunikacji pomiędzy miejscowościami Justynów i Janówka.

description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι οι εργασίες επισκευών-συντηρήσεων και η προμήθεια πάσης φύσεως ανταλλακτικών, εξαρτημάτων και ελαστικών των οχημάτων και μηχανημάτων έργου και αγροτικών μηχανημάτων του Δήμου Αλεξανδρούπολης, για χρονική διάρκεια δύο (2) ετών ή είκοσι τεσσάρων μηνών (24) (2026-2027-2028), με δικαίωμα προαίρεσης έως 50% και δυνατότητα παράτασης ενός έτους. description: Municipiul Targoviste a semnat Contractul de finantare nr. 220426 / 03.10.2025, inregistrat la Municipiul Targoviste cu nr. 113850/22.10.2025 in cadrul ,,Programului pentru eficienta energetica si energie regenerabila’’, Aria tematica ,,Eficienta energetica si energie regenerabila’’ din Programul de cooperare elvetiano-roman vizand reducerea disparitatilor economice si sociale in cadrul Uniunii Europene’’. Obiectivul are in vedere prețul la utilitățile publice (energie electrica, gaze naturale, combustibil) care in ultima perioada este in crestere continua, pe cale de consecință înregistrandu-se dificultăți în finanțarea activității curente, dar și în gestionarea prețului la utilitățile publice. Cad. 92953 are o suprafață construita de 4.410 mp, o suprafata desfasurata de 7.582 mp. Valoare estimata 224.659,21 lei fără TVA Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si complet tuturor sol.de clarificare/informati isuplim. adresate de catre op.ec., in a 11 a zi inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor,conform art. 161 din Legea nr.98/2016, coroborat cu art. 27 alin (3) din HG 395/2016, in masura in care aceste solicitari vor fi adresate pana la termenul limita de 17 zile inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor. title: Zeltbauarbeiten
description: Die Vergabe findet mittels teilfunktionaler Leistungsbeschreibung mit Leistungsverzeichnis statt. Im Folgenden wird dies vereinfacht als 'Leistungsverzeichnis' oder 'LV' benannt. Im Titel 01 angeboten werden soll die schlüsselfertige Herstellung des Werks, dessen Lieferung sowie ggf. der notwendige Umtransport auf der Baustelle, die Montage vor Ort und der Notdienst während des Festbetriebs. Das Hofbräu-Festzelt soll nach der Wiesn rückgebaut, eingelagert und für den Aufbau im nachfolgenden Jahr vorbereitet werden. Diese jährlichen Auf und Abbauarbeiten sowie die Einlagerung der Komponenten müssen ebenfalls angeboten werden und sind im Titel 02 - Jährlich wiederkehrende Bauleistungen - erfasst.. Das aktuelle Zelt hat bereits eine Nutzungsdauer von über 50 Jahren, das neue Zelt soll ebenfalls diese Nutzungsdauer erreichen. Alle dazu nötigen Bauteile und Komponenten sollen sehr langlebig ausgebildet werden und für ein jährliches Auf- und Abbauen konzipiert sein. Leistungen, welche im LV nicht näher oder nicht beschrieben sind, welche aber für das erfolgreiche Herstellen des Werkes benötigt werden, stellen keine Mehrvergütung dar. Alle Planungsleistungen, inkl. der zu erbringenden Tragwerksplanung sind in die Preise einzukalkulieren. Die in der Leistungsbeschreibung genannte Maße und Querschnitte sind nur Vorbemessungen und stellen keine endgültigen, konstruktiven Lösungen dar. Folgende Bauleistungen sind schlüsselfertig anzubieten: · 01 Sicherungseinrichtungen, Baustelleneinrichtung · 02 Erdbauarbeiten/Tiefbauarbeiten · 03 Zimmer- und Holzbauarbeiten · 04 Tischlerarbeiten

description:
Le présent appel d'offres concerne les prestations d’ingénierie et de montage de ligne de contact au sens des normes SIA, VSS, DE-OCF et RTE pour le Renouvellement de la voie entre Valeyres et Essert et entre le Bey et la Brinaz resp. Lot 1 et Lot 2.


Les deux secteurs de travail sont situés sur la ligne reliant Yverdon-les-Bains à Sainte Croix dans le canton de Vaud. Ligne exploitée par TRAVYS SA.


Pour le Lot 1 entre Valyeres-sous-Montagny et Essert-sous-Champvent (KM 4,130 à 5,350), des travaux de création d’infrastructure ferroviaire modifiant le tracé de la ligne sont prévus lors du clustering de l’été 2027 afin d’augmenter la vitesse de la ligne sur ce secteur particulier. Des travaux préliminaires de GC interviendront dès l’été 2026. Concernant la partie LC, il est prévu de renouveler une grande partie des mâts LC, et l’entier de la caténaire durant le clustering 2027.


Pour le Lot 2, entre Le Bey et La Brinaz (KM 1,415 à 2,040), des travaux de création d’infrastructure ferroviaire sont prévus lors du clustering de l’été 2027. De plus, un réaménagement des carrefours routiers sont prévus au niveau des 2 PN Le Bey, et Marché-de-Gros. Ceux-ci engendrant des conflits entre les installations ferroviaires et les zones de circulations prévues, un nouveau calepinage des mâts LC dans le secteur est prévu. Concernant la partie LC, il est prévu de renouveler une minorité de mâts LC, et de conserver l’entier de la caténaire durant le clustering 2027.

description:
L’onduleur alimentant les installations médicales de l’Hôpital orthopédique (HO) est vieillissant et des frais d’entretien conséquents sont à prévoir. Cet appareil est actuellement surdimensionné pour les installations qu’il sécurise.

Le but de cette nouvelle affaire est d’optimiser les coûts de maintenance pour les réseaux ASC de l’Hôpital orthopédique en dimensionnant plus justement ses installations selon les besoins réels. Cette optimisation se traduit concrètement par la fourniture de deux nouvelles chaînes d’onduleurs modulaires de 200 kVA / 200 kW destinées aux locaux techniques restructurés situés au niveau 02.


L’objectif est également d’optimiser la fiabilité du réseau ASC en utilisant mieux les surfaces à disposition du bâtiment, d’intégrer une solution de redondance ainsi que d’englober la quasi-totalité des réseaux ASC médicaux et techniques pour la partie Est du Bugnon (Hôpital orthopédique, Maternité, Clinique infantile, Nestlé et Beaumont), voir « Plan de zone » selon annexe 12.8.

title: Nmin sampling and analysis (Nmin method) as part of the Niederbipp-Gäu-Olten nitrate project (cantons of SO and BE)
description:
A key component of the nitrate project under Article 62a of the Federal Act

on the Protection of Waters, aimed at reducing nitrogen losses into groundwater, is fertilisation tailored to the specific site and based on actual needs. To this end, farms must fertilise their plots within the project perimeter either using the Nmin method or the method of corrected standards, in accordance with the guidelines for the fertilisation of agricultural crops in Switzerland (GRUD 2017). This service contract covers the collection and analysis of soil samples for Nmin analysis. On the basis of these Nmin analyses, the cantonal advisory services provide fertilisation recommendations to farmers.


Brief description of Nmin sampling:

  • Project management (planning, meetings, data management, report preparation),
  • ravel to the plots,
  • mechanised and, in some cases, manual collection of soil samples in the field (composite sample from a specified number of auger holes) for 3 depth intervals in arable farming (0–30 cm / 30–60 cm / 60–90 cm) and 2 to 3 depth intervals in vegetable farming (0–15 cm / 15–30 cm / 30–60 cm) in accordance with reference methods A 1.1 and A 1.2 VDLUFA (Methodology Handbook Volume I: Soils (Basic Work 1991) – VDLUFA),
  • delivery of the samples to the laboratory for analysis


Brief description of the analysis:

  • Sample preparation
  • Extraction and analysis of Nmin (nitrate and ammonium) and dry matter (in accordance with Agroscope reference methods),
  • Data transfer to the agricultural advisory services of the cantons of Solothurn (SO) and Bern (BE)

title: Sanierung Gimenenstrasse und Buswendeplatz
description:
Mit dem Projekt werden die Gimenenstrasse in der Stadt Zug saniert. Das Projekt wird als BIM-Pilotprojekt ausgeführt.

In der Gimenenstrasse wird die bestehende Strasseninfrastruktur im Abschnitt zwischen dem Hasenbüelweg und dem zukünftigen Buswendeplatz saniert und an die Entwicklungsziele des Quartiers angepasst. Die Fahrbahnbreite wird auf 5.50 m angepasst und der Gehweg mit einer Breite von generell 2.0 m erstellt. Zwischen Fahrbahn und Gehweg wird ein Grünstreifen angeordnet und durch neue Baumstandorte ergänzt.

Zusätzlich wird auf der Parzelle Nr. 3172 unterhalb des Kindergartens ein neuer Buswendeplatz mit Wendeschlaufe erstellt. Dieser ersetzt künftig die bestehende Endhaltestelle der Buslinie 614 am heutigen Strassenende. Vorgesehen sind eine 22er-Haltekante sowie eine neue Haltestelleninfrastruktur mit Personenunterstand und WC-Anlage.

Für die geordnete Ableitung des Oberflächenwassers wird im gesamten Projektperimeter eine neue Strassenentwässerung erstellt.

Die Wasserleitung DN 160 wird im Strassenperimeter ersetzt sowie die Beleuchtung und Rohranlage angepasst.

title: Sanierung Flur- & Frauentalstrasse, Cham
description:
Mit dem Projekt werden die Flur-, & Frauentalstrasse in der Gemeinde Cham des Kanton Zugs saniert.


Flurstrasse

Die Flurstrasse wird umfassend saniert. Der bestehende bituminöse Oberbau sowie die Gehwege und Randabschlüsse werden grösstenteils ersetzt.

Die Strassenentwässerung wird optimiert und durch eine neue Regenwasserleitung mit einer zusätzlichen Einleitung in die Lorze ergänzt.

Die WWZ Energie AG ersetzt abschnittsweise die Trinkwasserleitung. Zudem werden Hydranten, Hausanschlüsse, Ringleitungen, Schachtabdeckungen und weitere Werkleitungen angepasst beziehungsweise saniert.


Frauentalstrasse

Die Frauentalstrasse wird analog umfassend saniert. Dabei werden der Strassenoberbau, Gehwege und Randabschlüsse erneuert sowie die Entwässerung und Werkleitungen angepasst.

Elle couvre l’ensemble des travaux nécessaires à la réalisation du programme, y compris les démolitions et le curage, les installations provisoires et les dispositifs conservatoires liés au phasage en site occupé, ainsi que les voiries, réseaux divers et aménagements extérieurs. Elle s’entend hors honoraires, hors mobilier et hors désamiantage. Elle s’impose aux participants pour l’élaboration de leur projet : le respect de cette enveloppe conditionne l’appréciation portée au titre du critère n° 2 défini à l’article 16.1.Elle n’est pas négociable et constitue la base sur laquelle le titulaire souscrira, dans les conditions du marché, son engagement sur le coût prévisionnel des travaux. 1/Déroulement général: Le concours est organisé en deux phases : • Première phase : les candidats remettent un dossier de candidature complet permettant de vérifier les conditions de participation et de mettre en œuvre les critères de sélection définis dans l'avis de concours et précisés à l'article 10.2 du règlement de concours " phase candidatures". Le jury analyse les candidatures et formule un avis motivé sur celles-ci. Au vu de cet avis, L'acheteur retient ensuite au maximum trois candidats admis à concourir, sous réserve d'un nombre suffisant de candidatures recevables et présentant les capacités requises. • Deuxième phase : les participants remettent anonymement un dossier de projet dont le niveau de conception correspond à une esquisse +. Le jury examine les dossiers présentés sur la base des critères d'évaluation définis dans l'avis de concours et précisés à l'article 16.1 du règlement de concours " phase projet" puis établit un classement des projets. Après la levée de l’anonymat, sous réserve que le jury ait porté des demandes d’éclaircissements et des questions dans le procès-verbal, un dialogue peut s’établir avec les participants. L'acheteur choisit le ou les lauréats du concours au vu des procès-verbaux et de l'avis du jury. A l’issue du concours, conformément aux articles R. 2122-6 et R. 2172-2 du CCP, l’acheteur lance une procédure sans publicité ni mise en concurrence lui permettant de négocier avec le ou les lauréats, après le dépôt de l’offre, les conditions techniques, administratives et financières du marché de maitrise d’œuvre décrit à l’article 4 du règlement de concours.

description: De aanbestedingsprocedure heeft als doel om door middel van gunning een raamovereenkomst te sluiten met één (1) leverancier voor het onderhoud en de aanleg buitengroen en buitenterrein. Hogeschool Rotterdam zal onder de Raamovereenkomst een totaal geraamde waarde van maximaal €2.000.000 (exclusief BTW) afnemen. De totale opdrachtwaarde bedraagt op basis van historische gegevens gemiddeld € 235.000 excl. BTW per jaar. Aan deze opgave kunnen geen rechten ontleend worden. Met het oog op politieke, economische, budgettaire, organisatorische en/of bestuurlijke ontwikkelingen en de hiermee samenhangende groei en krimp van Hogeschool Rotterdam is het mogelijk dat het aantal locaties en andere specificaties waarop de Raamovereenkomst betrekking heeft kan uitbreiden, krimpen of wijzigen. title: Community Pharmacy Services - (Lot 1) Medicine Supply, (Lot 2) Clinical Support
description: Lincolnshire Community Health Services NHS Trust (LCHS) is seeking provider(s) to deliver Community Pharmacy Services through a PSR Competitive Process. The procurement comprises Lot 1: Medicines Supply, Dispensing and Distribution Services and Lot 2: Clinical Pharmacy Support Services. Contract term: 3 years plus up to 2 x 12-month extensions. Providers may bid for one or both Lots. Service commencement date: 01 April 2027. Additional information: To express interest and participate in the tender, please register and apply via Atamis e-sourcing portal https://health-family.force.com/s/Welcome. Should Tenderers have any queries, or having problems using the portal, they should contact Helpdesk at: Phone: 0800 9956035 E-mail: support-health@atamis.co.uk Provider Selection Regime (PSR) Competitive Process Lincolnshire Community Health Services NHS Trust (LCHS) is inviting suitably qualified, experienced and competent providers to participate in a Provider Selection Regime (PSR) Competitive Process for the provision of Community Pharmacy Services across Lincolnshire. The procurement is being undertaken in accordance with the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023 and has been structured to secure high-quality, resilient and sustainable pharmaceutical services that support patient care, medicines optimisation, medicines safety and service delivery across a diverse community healthcare environment. The procurement is divided into two Lots, allowing providers to bid for one Lot, both Lots, or any combination permitted within the procurement documentation: Lot 1 - Medicines Supply, Dispensing and Distribution Services The successful provider will be responsible for the procurement, dispensing, storage, distribution and supply of medicines and associated pharmaceutical products across a wide range of services. The service supports Community Hospitals, Urgent Treatment Centres (UTCs), Community Nursing Services, Integrated Community Teams, Home Visiting Services, Vaccination Services, Sexual Health Services and specialist HIV Services delivered across Lincolnshire and neighbouring areas. The provider will be expected to maintain robust medicines governance arrangements, support urgent and out-of-hours medicines requirements, manage medicines shortages and recalls, and provide a resilient medicines supply chain capable of supporting a geographically dispersed healthcare organisation. Lot 2 - Clinical Pharmacy Support Services The successful provider will deliver a comprehensive clinical pharmacy service supporting Community Hospitals, Urgent Treatment Centres, Butterfly Hospice, Sexual Health Services and HIV Services. Services will include medicines reconciliation, medicines optimisation, clinical pharmacy review, multidisciplinary team support, prescribing support, medicines governance, audit, education and training, patient counselling, specialist HIV pharmacy support and participation in quality improvement initiatives. Providers will be expected to deploy an appropriately skilled workforce comprising pharmacists, independent prescribers and pharmacy technicians capable of delivering consistent and high-quality pharmaceutical care across multiple sites.

title: NLP Condition Survey Programme
description: North Lanarkshire Properties (NLP) has a requirement to update its asset management register in respect of the condition of its property estate to ensure compliance with its statutory and legal obligations and to inform a multiyear investment strategy. The resulting dataset will form the foundation of NLP's future asset management, lifecycle investment, maintenance planning and portfolio optimisation activities. NLP manages a portfolio of approximately 990 assets. The current condition survey programme is anticipated to cover approximately 672 operational property assets, excluding ground lease assets and other property categories outside the scope of this procurement. Information is required on the following split: - 4 Business Centres - 28 Offices - 233 Retail - 402 Industrial - 5 Miscellaneous - 672 Total The procurement is for the appointment of suitably qualified and experienced building surveyor (a “Contractor”) to carry out condition surveys across a number of properties within the NLP portfolio. The aim of the resulting Agreement is to obtain by means of visual inspection consistent, accurate and actionable information regarding the physical condition, statutory compliance, risks, and investment needs of the defined buildings within the estate. Applying the findings to inform a data driven investment strategy to maximise portfolio value. The objectives are to: - Establish the current physical condition of each property asset defined. - Identify defects, risks, and compliance issues. - Provide an assessment of each asset’s life. - Provide prioritised maintenance actions. Year 1-5 with year 1 being the faults in most urgent need of attention. - Provide costs as a basis for estimating and to identify the level of funding required for future capital and revenue expenditure. - Provide sufficient information to allow a maintenance programme to be developed over a planned period that will support operational planning and asset management decision making - Deliver the condition survey in accordance with the following mandatory professional standards: a. RICS Building Surveying Standards & Guidance b. RICS Surveying Safely c. RICS New Rules of Measurement (NRM) for cost estimation d. PFI Asset Condition Playbook (2025) – survey methodology and reporting guidance e. General Implementation Guidance (2025) for asset condition hand back surveys f. Centre of Best Practice (CoBP) specification (where applicable) The purpose of the commission is to provide portfolio-wide condition intelligence to support NLP asset management and investment decisions through Level 1 visual, non-intrusive surveys.

title: NLP Condition Survey Programme
description: North Lanarkshire Properties (NLP) has a requirement to update its asset management register in respect of the condition of its property estate to ensure compliance with its statutory and legal obligations and to inform a multiyear investment strategy. The resulting dataset will form the foundation of NLP's future asset management, lifecycle investment, maintenance planning and portfolio optimisation activities. NLP manages a portfolio of approximately 990 assets. The current condition survey programme is anticipated to cover approximately 672 operational property assets, excluding ground lease assets and other property categories outside the scope of this procurement. Information is required on the following split: - 4 Business Centres - 28 Offices - 233 Retail - 402 Industrial - 5 Miscellaneous - 672 Total The procurement is for the appointment of suitably qualified and experienced building surveyor (a âContractorâ) to carry out condition surveys across a number of properties within the NLP portfolio. The aim of the resulting Agreement is to obtain by means of visual inspection consistent, accurate and actionable information regarding the physical condition, statutory compliance, risks, and investment needs of the defined buildings within the estate. Applying the findings to inform a data driven investment strategy to maximise portfolio value. The objectives are to: - Establish the current physical condition of each property asset defined. - Identify defects, risks, and compliance issues. - Provide an assessment of each assetâs life. - Provide prioritised maintenance actions. Year 1-5 with year 1 being the faults in most urgent need of attention. - Provide costs as a basis for estimating and to identify the level of funding required for future capital and revenue expenditure. - Provide sufficient information to allow a maintenance programme to be developed over a planned period that will support operational planning and asset management decision making - Deliver the condition survey in accordance with the following mandatory professional standards: a. RICS Building Surveying Standards & Guidance b. RICS Surveying Safely c. RICS New Rules of Measurement (NRM) for cost estimation d. PFI Asset Condition Playbook (2025) â survey methodology and reporting guidance e. General Implementation Guidance (2025) for asset condition hand back surveys f. Centre of Best Practice (CoBP) specification (where applicable) The purpose of the commission is to provide portfolio-wide condition intelligence to support NLP asset management and investment decisions through Level 1 visual, non-intrusive surveys.

The Proposer will assume any and all financial responsibilities for operations and maintenance of The Property under such a lease. The Property will be available at award in �as is� condition for no less than one ten (10) year base term. title: Construction of Chilled Water Plant and Site Utility Upgrades at VA Medical Center in West Haven, CT
description: The scope of the chilled water plant replacement consists of the demolition of the existing chilled water plant (building 16a) and construction of a new multi-story chilled water plant to include chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and all associated mechanical and electrical equipment. Due to the close proximity of the existing fuel tank farm adjacent to the existing chilled water plant, a new fuel tank farm will need to be constructed as part of the project, which primarily serves the central boiler plant, requiring close coordination with the medical center and ongoing related projects.The scope of the site utility upgrades consists of the replacement and upgrade of the existing fire protection water main and the domestic water main from Campbell Avenue to Building 15. Site utility upgrades also include providing utility main loops of chilled water supply and return, steam supply, condensate return, domestic water supply, and fire protection water supply which will originate from the new chilled water plant and back-feed to Building 1. The work also includes the installation of redundant electrical feeder from the utility demarcation point to Building 19 and coordination with the local electrical utility provider to provide further electrical redundancy offsite as well. In addition, new water storage tanks will be constructed. This project involves civil/site, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, geotechnical, and architectural disciplines. The project must also comply with the DVAs Physical Security Resiliency Design Requirements (PSRDM). It is expected that the chilled water plant will be constructed to meet USGBC LEED Silver certification. The work is located adjacent to and within an active Medical Center campus which will be operational at all times. Impact to on-going operations must be kept to a minimum and carefully coordinated with the Contracting Officer and VAMC staff. In addition, the work area is constrained due to the active medical center operations which will limit laydown and storage areas during construction.

title: Construction of Chilled Water Plant and Site Utility Upgrades at VA Medical Center in West Haven, CT
description: The scope of the chilled water plant replacement consists of the demolition of the existing chilled water plant (building 16a) and construction of a new multi-story chilled water plant to include chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and all associated mechanical and electrical equipment. Due to the close proximity of the existing fuel tank farm adjacent to the existing chilled water plant, a new fuel tank farm will need to be constructed as part of the project, which primarily serves the central boiler plant, requiring close coordination with the medical center and ongoing related projects.The scope of the site utility upgrades consists of the replacement and upgrade of the existing fire protection water main and the domestic water main from Campbell Avenue to Building 15. Site utility upgrades also include providing utility main loops of chilled water supply and return, steam supply, condensate return, domestic water supply, and fire protection water supply which will originate from the new chilled water plant and back-feed to Building 1. The work also includes the installation of redundant electrical feeder from the utility demarcation point to Building 19 and coordination with the local electrical utility provider to provide further electrical redundancy offsite as well. In addition, new water storage tanks will be constructed. This project involves civil/site, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, geotechnical, and architectural disciplines. The project must also comply with the DVAs Physical Security Resiliency Design Requirements (PSRDM). It is expected that the chilled water plant will be constructed to meet USGBC LEED Silver certification. The work is located adjacent to and within an active Medical Center campus which will be operational at all times. Impact to on-going operations must be kept to a minimum and carefully coordinated with the Contracting Officer and VAMC staff. In addition, the work area is constrained due to the active medical center operations which will limit laydown and storage areas during construction.

title: Palm Beach Harbor, South Jetty Rehabilitation 2026, Palm Beach County, Florida
description: A Pre-Bid Conference will be held via teleconference on October 7, 2026 @ 10:00am EDT. The call-in number is: +1 601-262-2433, the Access Code is: 208 969 158#, Attendee ID: 993 907 442 865 / Passcode: bm7je2Mr and the link to be utilized is as follows: HTTPS://WWW.MICROSOFT.COM/EN-US/MICROSOFT-TEAMS/JOIN-A-MEETINGIt is requested that an email be sent to Guesley.Leger@usace.army.mil no later than October 5, 2026, at 04:00pm, EDT to confirm attendance by your organization. DESCRIPTION OF WORK: The work consists of rehabilitation of the South Jetty at Palm Beach Harbor. Rehabilitation will require substantial moving and manipulation of both new and existing stones to obtain the required interlocking within the tolerances provided. Mobilization of equipment and the construction necessary to repair the jetty must be water-based and require the use of marine construction methods and equipment. Work on top of the jetty will be permitted. Land-based access to the project site will not be permitted. Rehabilitation also consists of concrete repairs to the South Jetty at Palm Beach Harbor as indicated on the drawings. Prior to work on the jetty, conduct a pre-construction benthic community survey on the jetty structure and any adjacent submerged areas that may be impacted by the Contractors operations. Complete any coral relocations required as a result of the benthic survey prior to jetty work. Field personnel conducting coral survey and transplantation activities must either be qualified relocation contractors by the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission or must provide documentation of having successfully conducted relocation of corals in Florida. The project will have an estimated period of performance of 330 calendar days after receipt of the Notice to Proceed (NTP). Under this CSO, all products, technologies, and services shall be treated as commercial items; products, technologies, and services do not have to be �commercially available� to be submitted in response to this solicitation. If the solution meets the requirements of the regulation, the solution is treated as commercial whereby the Contracting Officer will utilize commercial procedures to develop and execute the resultant award. The DoW High Performance Computing Modernization Program (HPCMP) is seeking innovative solutions to establish a new high-performance computing (HPC) system acquisition and support services model that leverages industry best practices to transform how the HPCMP procures, operates, and maintains its newest HPC systems for 2027. The HPC systems being considered are a combination of compute-intensive architectures and artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) platforms operating in either unclassified or classified (secret and above-secret) environments. The systems would be geographically distributed at up to three of the five HPCMP DoW Supercomputing Resource Centers (DSRCs). Since the systems will reside on-premises in the DSRCs, the services model must also conform to DoW and local Service policies, especially regarding security (physical, personnel, and cyber). To navigate the current market conditions and meet mission objectives, a new strategy is needed to design, manufacture, deliver, install, operate and maintain one or more HPC systems at one to three different HPC centers. The anticipated systems will be a combination of compute-intensive architectures (mostly CPU-based) and artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) platforms (mostly GPU-based) operating in either unclassified or classified (secret and above-secret) environments. Go to https://www.erdcwerx.org/innovative-technology-insertion-of-advanced-hpc-systems/ for all of the CSO details and submission requirements. All solutions must be submitted through the ERDCWERX platform. The ERDC may award a FAR-based contract or an Other Transaction under this announcement. All resultant FAR-based contracts will be firm-fixed price. All items, technologies, and services (including research and development) procured via this CSO are treated as commercial. Applicants from universities and/or non-profit organizations should be aware that commercial clauses will be integrated into the award and should coordinate proposals with associated legal counsel prior to submission.

title: Sanierung Heizzentrale Areal Stiftung Schürmatt, Zetzwil
description:
Die bestehende Wärmeerzeugungsanlage des Areals wird umfassend saniert und ersetzt. Der bestehende Hackgutkessel sowie der bestehende Ölkessel inklusive Öltankanlage und den nicht mehr benötigten Installationen werden demontiert und fachgerecht entsorgt.

Als Ersatz werden im bestehenden Kesselraum zwei neue Hackgutkessel in Kaskadenschaltung installiert. Die neuen Wärmeerzeuger werden hydraulisch in den bestehenden Heizungsverteiler eingebunden. Der bestehende Heizungsverteiler sowie die vorhandenen Wärmespeicher bleiben erhalten; die Speicher werden entsprechend der neuen Anlagenkonzeption hydraulisch neu eingebunden.

Die Abgasanlage wird für die neuen Wärmeerzeuger angepasst bzw. erweitert und an die bestehende Kaminanlage angebunden.

Sämtliche für den Anlagenersatz erforderlichen hydraulischen, elektrischen sowie mess-, steuer- und regeltechnischen Anpassungen sind Bestandteil der Arbeiten. Die bestehende Gebäudeautomation wird an die neue Wärmeerzeugung angepasst und entsprechend erweitert.

Die Arbeiten erfolgen im Wesentlichen innerhalb der bestehenden Heizzentrale bzw. des Kesselraums.

description: Headquarters (HQ) Air Mobility Command (AMC) Communications Directorate (A67A) requires the purchase of Brand Name Only Palo Alto software. Palo Alto is a virtual (software) firewall that supports EACN's 10 gigabit architecture and enhances customer connection ability. The licenses required for this requirement are Palo Alto Networks VM-Series, Next Gen Firewall (NGFW) credits for Threat Prevention and Palo Alto Networks Premium Support Program for Panorama. The BNO Palo Alto Software is required to support EACN�s security policies to maintain positive control of the network, improve security efficacy and reduce security response times. These virtual machines are needed to analyze traffic to identify users/applications and determine applicable content. Without these licenses, EACN would become significantly compromised, presenting a larger attack surface for potential cyber threats. In addition, a gap in support could cause a network interruption in communications service and security. Palo Alto is the only software certified to be used with EACN and is the industry standard. Palo Alto is an other than small business selling these licenses through authorized resellers.

title: U.S. Customs and Border Protection Less Lethal Specialty Impact/Chemical Munitions (LLSI CM) Request for Information
description: INTRODUCTION The Law Enforcement Safety and Compliance Directorate (LESC), on behalf of Operations Support (OS), U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), and U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) is conducting market research to gain a greater understanding of the full range of available options for industry�s ability to provide CBP with suitable Distraction Devices, Specialty Impact and Chemical Munitions, hand delivered and launched in 40mm launchers which meet the government�s preliminarily identified requirements. This is an RFI released pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10 � Market Research. This RFI�s purpose is to obtain market information on viable sources of supply, industry practices, answers to specific questions, and industry comments. All RFI submissions become Government property and will not be returned. This announcement constitutes an official Request for Information (RFI). Further, U.S. Customs and Border Protection is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Your response to this RFI will be treated as information only. No entitlement to payment of direct or indirect costs or charges by the Government will arise as a result of contractor submission of responses to this announcement or Government use of such information. No funds have been authorized, appropriated, or received for this effort. The information provided may be used by CBP in developing and refining its Acquisition Strategy, Statement of Work, and Performance Specifications. Interested parties are responsible for adequately marking proprietary or competition sensitive information contained in their response. The U.S. Government does not intend to award a contract solely on the basis of this RFI or to otherwise pay for the information submitted in response to same. The U.S. Government is not obligated to notify respondents of the results of this survey. DESCRIPTION This initiative, Less Lethal Specialty Impact/Chemical Munitions, is an updated requirement to allow U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Components, and other federal agencies the ability to supply their armed workforce with Distraction Devices, Specialty Impact and Chemical Munitions, hand delivered and launched in 40mm launchers, for training and operational use, while achieving significant cost savings. CBP intends to solicit for a 5-year Indefinite Delivery / Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Contract. This contract is intended to be a Multi-Agency Contract (MAC). INFORMATION REQUESTED: Company Name, Company Address, Point of Contact, Telephone Number, and e-mail Address. CBP intends to use North America Industrial Classification System (NAICS) 332994 Small Arms and other Ordnances and Accessories? What NAICS code do you think, if any, is more appropriate for CBP to use? What size business are you registered as with NAICS Code 332994? Are you a manufacturer or distributor/reseller of LLSI CMs? If you a distributor, are you an authorized distributor capable of providing an authorization letter from the manufacturer? What is your organization�s experience with, and capability of, manufacturing and distributing less lethal distraction devices, specialty impact and chemical munitions for military or law enforcement agencies? Does this experience include designing specific devices to meet agency/military technical requirements? Where are your devices manufactured and/or assembled? If parts/components are manufactured in a different location from final assembly, please identify all subcontractors� names and locations. What percentage of the devices are manufactured and assembled in the U.S.? Is your organization capable of manufacturing or providing devices that meet all technical requirements included in the attached draft Statement of Work (SOW)? If not, please identify the items that you are NOT able to provide? Does your organization offer the devices with a warranty? If yes, please provide warranty length, and coverage of warranty. Is your organization (or the manufacturer) ISO Certified? If so, to what standard? Provide a synopsis of current Quality Control processes related to the devices. Provide your total manufacturing capacity for all categories of devices outlined in the draft Statement of Work on a quarterly basis. What is your surge capacity for each category of device outlined in the draft Statement of Work that will be devoted to this contract? What is the normal lead-time for delivery of devices once an order is received? Do you have any concerns or questions regarding the requirements set forth in the attached draft Statement of Work? RESPONSES The information provided may be used by CBP in developing and refining its Acquisition Strategy, Statement of Work, and Performance Specifications. Responses shall be the minimum length necessary to accommodate all requested information and submitted via e-mail only. Proprietary information, if any, should be minimized and MUST BE CLEARLY MARKED. To aid the Government, please segregate proprietary information. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFP, if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the official Government Point of Entry site System for Award Management (SAM.gov) website. It is the responsibility of the potential offerors to monitor these sites for additional information pertaining to this requirement. QUESTIONS Questions regarding this announcement shall be submitted in writing by e-mail to the Contracting Officer, email address listed below. Verbal questions will NOT be accepted. Questions, if not answered directly to the respondee, will be answered by posting on the SAM.gov website; accordingly, questions shall NOT contain proprietary, sensitive, or classified information. Instructions and Response Guidelines: Please provide the information you deem relevant in order to respond to the specific inquiries of the RFI. The information provided will be used solely by CBP as market research. This RFI is for information and planning purposes only and does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid, or Request for Quotation (RFQ), and it is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to enter into a contract, nor will the Government pay for the information submitted in response to this request. All information contained in this RFI is preliminary as well as subject to modification and is in no way binding on the Government. RFI Responses shall be submitted electronically via email to the Contacting Officer, Jared Tritle at Jared.a.tritle@cbp.dhs.gov no later than 2:00 p.m. EST on Friday, October 24, 2025. Telephone responses will not be accepted. The Government is not required to respond to any information provided in response to this RFI. It is the responsibility of the interested parties to monitor SAM.gov for additional information pertaining to this RFI.

title: Dehydrated Food Waste By-Product
description: FCI Sandstone, Minnesota is looking for a compost manufacturer or like company to recycle our dehydrated food waste. We have two dehydrator units, which we use to dehydrate our scrap foods for weight reduction. The by-product produced from the process is nutrient-rich and is safe for commercial farming and gardening. We are looking for a company who could use the byproduct for making compost or using it for their farming or gardening needs. The product when dehydrated has an appearance like dry coffee grounds. We are looking for a company who would provide a 2�3-yard storage container for the product with a pickup schedule of every other week, pickups could vary depending on storage containers size. As the product can be used to generate benefits, we would like to set up a contract to sell the product to a vendor. Please see the attached lab results for the nutrient values of the by-product.

description: (a) The Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose offer conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. description:
CFF SA exploite une flotte de wagons de montage pour la construction de lignes de contact qui a atteint la fin de son cycle de vie. Les présentes conditions de l’appel d’offres et l’ensemble des documents associés visent à acquérir une nouvelle flotte de wagons de montage pour ligne de contact (Wagon MT LC) plus modernes et neutres pour le climat. La nouvelle flotte de MT LC doit répondre aux dernières exigences en matière de technique, de normes, de sécurité et de technique énergétique.


Les prestations faisant l’objet de l’appel d’offres portent essentiellement sur le développement, la planification, la fabrication, la mise en service, l’homologation, la livraison et le suivi (au moins pendant la phase de garantie) des véhicules ainsi que sur la documentation et la formation relatives aux véhicules. 


Sur demande, l’entreprise peut acheter des wagons plats (de type Lns) aux CFF à prix de revient. Ces wagons serviront de base aux superstructures correspondantes. La mise à disposition des wagons par les CFF est également possible. En cas de mise à disposition éventuelle, les coûts des wagons plats, y compris les frais de manutention selon le contrat de vente, sont ajoutés au prix proposé afin de garantir la comparabilité des offres.

title: Lithuania – Architectural design services – Totoriškių ežero pakrantės Trakuose viešosios erdvės kompleksinio sutvarkymo projektavimo ir projekto vykdymo priežiūros paslaugos
description: VViešosios erdvės ir želdynų kompleksinio sutvarkymo, kitų inžinerinių statinių paskirties grupės (kitos paskirties statinių), susisiekimo komunikacijų statinių paskirties grupės (gatvių paskirties statinio) – pėsčiųjų tako, inžinerinių tinklų paskirties grupės statinių (vandentiekio, nuotekų šalinimo, elektros tinklų paskirties statinių) Totoriškių ežero pakrantėje (atkarpa nuo Trakų g. iki ežero kranto), Trakuose, statybos projektas ir projekto vykdymo priežiūros paslaugos. Numatyta suprojektuoti pėsčiųjų taką, lieptus ir aikšteles, viešąją maudyklą, mažosios architektūros elementus, apšvietimą, inžinerinius tinklus bei apie 160–170 m ilgio elektromechaninę keleivinę perkėlą per Totoriškių ežerą. Paslaugos apima reikalingų tyrimų atlikimą, projektinių sprendinių ir projekto parengimą bei suderinimą, reikalingų pritarimų ir statybą leidžiančio dokumento gavimą, projekto pateikimą ekspertizei ir koregavimą pagal jos pastabas bei projekto vykdymo priežiūrą statybos darbų metu. Projektas turi būti parengtas ir suderintas su Statytoju (Užsakovu), parengti projektiniai pasiūlymai turi būti viešinami teisės aktų nustatyta tvarka (jeigu to reikalauja teisės aktai). Pirmo etapo užbaigimas - statybą leidžiančio dokumento gavimas pagal projektinius pasiūlymus (jeigu to reikalauja teisės aktai). Prieš pradedant rengti projektą privalu atlikti archeologinius ar kitus privalomuosius tyrimus, nuo kurių priklausys projekto apimtis ir projekto etapų kiekis. Vėliau privalomai gauti specialiuosius reikalavimus ir prisijungimo sąlygas, atlikti kitus tyrimus ir t.t. Surinkti būtinus duomenis, reikalingus Statinio projektui. Parengti, suderinti su Užsakovu bei jam perduoti Užsakovo planuojamo statyti Statinio pilnos sudėties projektą (toliau – Projektas). Organizuoti ir atlikti visus Sutartyje ir techninėje užduotyje numatytų darbų atlikimui; organizuoti Kūrybines dirbtuves; Privalomųjų tyrimų atlikimas; Analogų paieška Europoje; 2-3 gatvės variantų parengimas; jų pristatymas, aptarimas ir vertinimas, vieno varianto pasirinkimas – modeliavimas iš kelių variantų; pasirinkto varianto pristatymas visuomenei; Projektas rengiamas dviem etapais: pirma rengiami projektiniai pasiūlymai, pagal kuriuos išduodamas statybą leidžiantis dokumentas, vėliau – techninis darbo projektas (pagal poreikį); Projekto vykdymo priežiūros paslaugos statybos rangos darbų metu; Kitos techninėje užduotyje aprašytos paslaugos; parengti topografinių tyrinėjimų ataskaitą; atlikti projektinius inžinerinius geologinius ir geotechninius tyrimus, gauti jų ataskaitą su tyrimų registravimo numeriu Žemės gelmių registre ir Lietuvos geologijos tarnybos rašto apie šios ataskaitos vertinimą ir priėmimą kopiją; gauti žemės valdytojų sutikimus (esant poreikiui); gavus bendrosios, specialiosios ekspertizės ir derinimo IS Infostatyba institucijų pastabas atsižvelgti ir taisyti sprendinius. Veikiant Užsakovo vardu paslaugų tekėjas gauna statybą leidžiantį dokumentą ir visus kitus suderinimus, patvirtinimus ir leidimus, reikalingus techninio darbo projekto tinkamam parengimui ir vėlesniam Statinio statybos vykdymui, pagal parengtą techninį darbo projektą bei atlikti projekto vykdymo priežiūrą. Projekto užbaigimu laikomas teigiamas Techninio darbo projekto ekspertizės aktas.

title: Netherlands – Airport lighting – Vliegveldverlichtingsproducten
description: De opdracht betreft het leveren van vliegverlichtingsproducten voor de voorraad van het ministerie van Defensie. Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) besteedt voor defensie baanrenovaties van vliegvelden aan. RVB besteedt deze baanrenovatie normaliter per vliegveld aan. Dit betreft dan een werken aanbesteding, waarin de vliegveldverlichting is meegenomen. Voor de behoefte aan reserveonderdelen voor vliegveldverlichting koopt RVB normaliter 10% extra vliegveldverlichting in voor Defensie. Dit wordt op voorraad genomen door de Service Dienstvastgoed Defensie (SVD), de eigen vastgoedstoringsdienst van Defensie die hiermee vervanging en onderhoud aan vliegveldverlichting uit kan voeren. Door een beleidswijziging bij Defensie ten gevolge van geopolitieke spanningen, wenst Defensie een voorraad vliegveldverlichting aan te leggen om in staat te zijn 90 dagen lang de verlichting op vliegvelden te kunnen onderhouden en vervangen. Dit overstijgt de 10% aan vliegveldverlichting per baanrenovatie die het RVB normaliter voor Defensie inkoopt. Voor deze aanvullende behoefte zijn geen bestaande overeenkomsten voorhanden bij het RVB of Defensie. Deze aanbesteding dient om overeenkomst(en) af te sluiten. De behoefte van Defensie voor een voorraad vliegveldverlichting heeft een sterke verbinding met de vliegveldverlichting die reeds opgesteld staat op de Defensie vliegvelden in Nederland. Immers, als vliegveldverlichting vervangen moet worden dan dient dat in veel gevallen exact hetzelfde product te zijn. Dit is o.a. vanwege comptabiliteit en juiste werking van de vliegveldverlichting en dit zorgt ervoor dat veilige start- en landingen van de piloten op de Defensie vliegvelden kunnen worden geborgd. In de meeste gevallen geldt: indien niet exact hetzelfde product wordt geïnstalleerd is dat een risico voor veilige start- en landingen. Defensie heeft uit veiligheidsoverwegingen haar behoefte in deze aanbesteding daarom deels technisch gespecificeerd. Daar waar het mogelijk is, heeft Defensie functioneel gespecifieerd. Defensie heeft haar behoefte ingedeeld in 3 percelen (zie paragraaf 1.2), zodat in een betreffend perceel zowel producent(en) als groothandel(s)/distributeur(s) van vliegveldverlichting kunnen inschrijven. Per Perceel betreft de opdracht: - Levering van de vliegveldverlichtingsproducten in scope van het betreffende perceel door Opdrachtnemer aan Opdrachtgever op locatie(s) van Opdrachtgever in Nederland; - Waar nodig adviseren van Opdrachtgever door Opdrachtnemer over de juiste levering van vliegveldverlichtingsproducten in scope van het betreffende perceel. Dit vereist onder meer van Opdrachtnemer: o De productstructuur en artikelcoderingen kennen en beheersen; o de juiste componenten kunnen identificeren op basis van onderdeelnummer of configuratie; o wijzigingen, opvolgende typen en vervangende onderdelen herkennen; o weten welke onderdelen wel en niet uitwisselbaar zijn; o toegang hebben tot de juiste supply chain. Buiten scope: - levering van veldborden t.b.v. vliegvelden; - installatie en elektrotechnische werkzaamheden aan vliegveldverlichtingsproducten.

buyer: TED - Entsorgung + Recycling Zürich (ERZ) Hagenholzstrasse 110, Zürich
title: Switzerland – Event services – Realisierung eines Bildungszentrums und betrieblicher Support / Subm. Nr.: 2026-16
description: Entsorgung + Recycling Zürich (ERZ) möchte ein neues, interaktives Bildungszentrum mit Fokus auf die Themen Kreislaufwirtschaft und Gewässerschutz am Standort Hagenholz realisieren. Das Bildungszentrum (Arbeitstitel) soll aufzeigen und erlebbar machen, was ERZ insgesamt für die Stadt Zürich und im Besonderen in den Bereichen Umwelt, Kreislaufwirtschaft und Gewässerschutz leistet. Der Fokus soll darauf liegen, den Besucher*innen praxisorientiertes Wissen zu vermitteln und Verhaltensänderungen in den Bereichen Abfall / Kreislaufwirtschaft und Gewässerschutz anzuregen. Das Grobkonzept sieht ein interaktives, modernes und modular anpassbares Bildungszentrum vor. Der eine Teil des Bildungszentrums (Erdgeschoss) soll als Stadtspaziergang gestaltet werden. Darin werden die vielfältigen Leistungen von ERZ für ein lebenswertes Zürich aufgezeigt und Wissen rund um Kreislaufwirtschaft, Regenwassermanagement und Gewässerschutz vermittelt. Der zweite Teil (Obergeschoss) leitet die Besuchenden durch eine beispielhafte Stadtzürcher Wohnung und zeigt auf, welchen Handlungsspielraum die Besuchenden selbst haben, um zu einem lebenswerten Zürich beizutragen. Dadurch wird der Wissenstransfer zur Lebensrealität der Besuchenden sichergestellt und somit auch eine potenzielle Verhaltensänderung im Alltag begünstigt. Das Konzept ist modular angedacht, Stationen auf dem Stadtspaziergang und in der Wohnung können bei Bedarf angepasst oder ausgetauscht werden. Informationen rund um aktuelle ERZ-Projekte lassen sich einfach und rasch aktualisieren. Die Stationen sind selbsterklärend, es braucht keine Führung. Virtuelle Personen («Companions») begleiten die Besuchenden durch die Ausstellung. Die Ausstellung wird in bestehenden Räumlichkeiten am Standort Hagenholz umgesetzt. Es bedarf eines Rückbaus der aktuellen Einrichtung, bestimmter Wände und Bodenaufbauten, Anpassungen am Eingang sowie neuer Geländer, damit die Räumlichkeiten in der Form zur Verfügung stehen, wie es für den Innenausbau der Ausstellung erforderlich ist. Dieser Rückbau ist nicht Teil dieser Submission, sondern wird durch ein von ERZ beauftragtes Architekturbüro geplant und ausgeführt, welches auch die Baubewilligung einholen wird.
